text:
Introduction:

First sentence:

Long style: I am writing this letter to refer you Ms Patrick, a 30 years age sales person, who is
presenting with symptoms and signs suggestive of gout.

Short style: I am writing to refer you Ms Patrick, a 30-year-old patient, who is presenting with
symptoms and signs suggestive of gout.

Very short style: I am writing to refer you Ms Patrick, who is presenting with symptoms and signs
suggestive of gout.

Ultra short: Thank you for seeing Ms Patrick, a 30-year-old………

Second sentence:

Long style: I will be glad if you could manage her condition as you think appropriate.

Short style:

-Her condition needs your further management.

-Her condition is getting much better.

-Her condition is getting progressively worse.

-Your further management is highly appreciated.

                                                Conclusion:

Long style: My provisional diagnosis is gout. Thus, (Or Therefore,) I am referring this patient for
further management of her condition. For further queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Short style: My provisional diagnosis is gout. Thus, (Or Therefore,) I am referring this patient for
further management.

                                                   Body 1

Ms Patrick is married with three children. However she does not smoke, she is a heavy drinker.
Regarding her medical history, she is ……………….

                                                   Body 2

On 07/03/2013, the patient presented complaining of ---------. Consequently, blood tests were
ordered which revealed--------. A month later, she attended the clinic for ---------. Later on,-------------.

                                                   Body 3

Today, the patient "Ms Patrick" came reporting that (to) ----------. Thus,------------------.
